verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general-purpose agents that can fix bugs and open PRs, plus a PR-review flow that runs a security and secrets scan. Nothing documents ingesting security alerts (e.g., from a scanner) and automatically validating and remediating them with a pull request. The generic bug-fix, PR-creation and API-trigger capabilities are building blocks or adjacent features, not this story's capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
